title: 读这份公告
别只读正文
points: 截止日 = 2026 年 8月5日。这个日期只写在公告顶部的更新横幅里(5月1日 改期而来),正文有二十多处仍写着 5月1日 —— 照抄正文会差三个月。
受灾范围 = 24 个县 + 25 个部落领地。正文只列了最初的 17 项(其中 Samish 是部落不是县),扩大的 9 个县同样只在横幅里。
地址在受灾范围内的自动适用,无需申请;县外但账册或记账人在内的,现在就致电 IRS 灾害热线。
逐项覆盖范围(哪些申报与缴款在内)正文仍是改期前口径,Q2 项目是否随窗口顺延,建议直接向 IRS 确认再答复客户。

title: Read the banner,
not just the body
points: The deadline is Aug 5, 2026 — stated only in the update banner (moved from May 1). The body text below it still says May 1 in more than twenty places; transcribing the body leaves you three months stale.

The covered area is 24 counties and 25 tribal nations. The body lists only the original 17 entries (one of which, Samish, is a tribal nation, not a county); the 9 added counties appear only in the banner.
Relief is automatic for an IRS address of record in the area. Client outside it but records or preparer inside? Call the IRS disaster hotline today, not Wednesday.
The item-by-item list of what's postponed is still written to the pre-extension window. Confirm with the IRS whether Q2 items follow the new date before you answer a client.
